estonia.description: Amiért megosztotta Kocsis Máté becsületsértő posztját.

estonia.title: Ukrán dróncsapás ért egy személyvonatot a Krímben
estonia.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

estonia.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
estonia.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. A könyv bemutatóján a szerzővel beszélgettünk.

estonia.title: Bocsánatot kért egy német szálloda, mert azt írta egy izraeli érdeklődőnek, hogy zsidókat nem engednek a szállodába
estonia.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

estonia.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
estonia.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

estonia.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
estonia.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

estonia.title: Már a Kreml is elismeri: tarolnak az ukrán drónok, fordulhat a kocka - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúból kedden
estonia.description: Már Dmitrij Peszkov Kreml-szóvivő is elismeri, hogy az ukrán mélységi dróncsapások komoly fejtörést okoznak az orosz üzemanyagellátásnak. A pilóta nélküli fegyvereknek hála az orosz területszerzés 2023 óta először negatívba fordult. A drónháború elmérgesedésével egyre gyakrabban bukkannak fel orosz és ukrán drónok NATO-tagállamok területén: Romániában egy ukrán tengeri drón okozott botrányt, a baltikumban repülő eszközök borzolják a kedélyeket. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfontosabb híreivel.

estonia.title: Paweł Kowal o obecności wojsk USA w Polsce. "Dobre wieści przywożę"
estonia.description: Przekaz jest jasny - Polska zasługuje na to, żeby skoncentrować to wsparcie Stanów Zjednoczonych na wschodniej flance NATO - powiedział szef sejmowej komisji spraw zagranicznych Paweł Kowal z KO. Poseł był niedawno gościem w amerykańskim Kongresie. O swojej wizycie mówił w "Faktach po Faktach" TVN24.

estonia.title: Konflikt o "Bohaterów UPA". Donald Tusk: Ukraina ma więcej roboty do wykonania
estonia.description: Trudne sąsiedzkie relacje trzeba budować na prawdzie i na próbie zrozumienia wzajemnych intencji. Ukraińcy tego nie zrobili i mamy dzisiaj z tym poważny kłopot - stwierdził Donald Tusk na konferencji prasowej. Jego zdaniem Ukraina powinna "przejąć odpowiedzialność za kryzys" spowodowany nazwaniem jednostki wojskowej imieniem "Bohaterów UPA". Szef rządu był również pytany, czemu prezydent Ukrainy poleciał do Londynu przez Mołdawię, a nie - jak zwykle - przez Rzeszów.

estonia.title: Rok temu "nie dawano jej szans", teraz ma "wyciągnąć partię z dołka"
estonia.description: Ma doświadczenie w wyborach i w zarządzaniu miastem, ale nie obciąża jej otoczenie poprzedniej ekipy. Senatorka Koalicji Obywatelskiej Monika Piątkowska została kandydatką na prezydenta Krakowa. - Jest w gronie faworytów, ale nie jest też bezapelacyjnym faworytem - skomentował dla TVN24+ prof. Jarosław Flis, socjolog z Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego.

estonia.title: ONLINE: Silný odkaz zo severu: Ukrajina smeruje nezvratne do NATO, v EÚ ju chcú čo najskôr
estonia.description: Vojna na Ukrajine trvá už 1 566 dní.

estonia.title: Zelenskyj nabídl Pobaltí ukrajinské experty na boj proti dronům
estonia.description: Ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj v úterý v estonském Tallinnu prohlásil, že Kyjev je připraven vyslat své specialisty na boj proti dronům do evropských zemí, které ohrožují bezpilotní letouny. Pobaltí a Finsko v posledních měsících opakovaně čelily incidentům, kdy do jejich vzdušného prostoru vletěly ukrajinské drony původně útočící na cíle v Rusku.

estonia.title: Lidé vyběhli při zemětřesení na Filipínách z restaurace jen pár vteřin předtím, než se zřítila
estonia.description: KRÁTCE: Děsivý okamžik natočil v pondělí očitý svědek během devastujícího zemětřesení na Filipínách. Na záběrech je vidět, jak šla k zemi budova, ve které sídlila restaurace Jollibee ve městě General Santos, jen zhruba 15 vteřin poté, co z ní vyběhli lidé. Při zemětřesení o síle 7,8 stupně Richterovy škály zemřelo podle nejnovějších informací nejméně 37 lidí a stovky dalších byly zraněny, uvádí agentura Reuters. Epicentrum se nacházelo v moři nedaleko od pobřeží ostrova Mindanao. Úřady vydaly také varování před tsunami.

estonia.title: Ruskou stínovou flotilu střeží Wagnerovci
estonia.description: Na lodích ruské stínové flotily hlídkují jako ozbrojená ochranka bývalí příslušníci ruské paramilitární organizace Wagnerovců. Mají sloužit jako odstrašení pro úřady zemí NATO a udržovat disciplínu u posádky.

estonia.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
estonia.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

estonia.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
estonia.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

estonia.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
estonia.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

estonia.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
estonia.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

estonia.title: Militari români și americani s-au antrenat împreună în Polonia. Mesajul Ambasadei SUA la București
estonia.description: Militari români și americani au participat la un antrenament comun în Polonia, iar imaginile au fost preluate de Ambasada SUA la București. Exercițiul militar a avut loc la Bemowo Piskie, unde este staționat Grupul de Luptă Multinațional al NATO în Polonia.

estonia.title: Avioane NATO au doborât o dronă intrată în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia
estonia.description: Avioane NATO au doborât luni o dronă care a intrat în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia, după ce autoritățile au emis avertizări pentru locuitorii din estul țării să se adăpostească. Originea aparatului de zbor nu a fost stabilită imediat.

estonia.title: Cum vor SUA să forțeze Iranul să ofere informații despre instalațiile nucleare bombardate și stocul de uraniu îmbogățit
estonia.description: Statele Unite fac lobby pe lângă alte ţări din Consiliul Guvernatorilor al Agenţiei Internaţionale pentru Energie Atomică (AIEA) să sprijine un proiect de rezoluţie care ar dispune Iranului să informeze acest organism cu privire la situaţia instalaţiilor sale nucleare bombardate anul trecut şi anul acesta de SUA şi Israel, precum a uraniului îmbogăţit depozitat acolo, relatează Reuters.

estonia.title: Metz Handball a câştigat în premieră Liga Campionilor, după ce a trecut în finală de Gyor, deținătoarea trofeului
estonia.description: Metz Handball a devenit prima echipă franceză care câştigă Liga Campionilor la handbal feminin, după ce a învins-o în finală pe Gyori Audi ETO KC, deţinătoarea trofeului, cu 31-29 (18-17), duminică, în MVM Dome din Budapesta, în timp ce CSM Bucureşti a obţinut medaliile de bronz.

estonia.title: Triathlete Kaidi Kivioja sets Estonian record in full Ironman debut
estonia.description: Estonian endurance athlete Kaidi Kivioja made her full-distance Ironman triathlon debut at the European Championships in Hamburg, setting a new domestic record in the process.

estonia.title: Tallinn to boost school lunch funding from September 1
estonia.description: The City of Tallinn is hiking school lunch funding starting this fall, increasing the daily lunch rate to €2.10 to help maintain meal quality amid rising costs.

estonia.title: At 89, Neeme Järvi reflects on a lifetime in music: 'You embrace the whole world'
estonia.description: Conductor Neeme Järvi, who has just turned 89, said he feels a powerful drive within him that is very hard to slow down. According to Järvi, conducting is the best profession because through music you can embrace the whole world. He was guided toward music by his mother, who was a hairdresser, and his role model was his brother Vallo, who was 14 years older.

estonia.title: Four new clay courts to replace Kadriorg's old tennis infrastructure
estonia.description: Kadriorg Tennis Center has begun reconstructing its old courts and will replace them with four upgraded clay courts, which are expected to be completed later this summer. The center is also in talks with the City of Tallinn about building a new tennis hall.

estonia.title: Gallery: Olena Zelenska, Sirje Karis meet with academic leaders in Tallinn
estonia.description: Ukrainian First Lady Olena Zelenska and Estonian First Lady Sirje Karis met education and research leaders in Tallinn on Tuesday, with a focus on academic cooperation.

estonia.title: Gallery: Architecture students build a new landmark for Tartu from ruins
estonia.description: The traditional construction workshop of first-year architecture and urban planning students from the Estonian Academy of Arts (EKA) began next to the Annelinn Library in Tartu. This year's shelter, titled "Varem" ("Before"), focuses on the life cycle of buildings and reuse, offering the local community a new type of meeting place.

estonia.title: OECD urges Estonia to tighten budget, reform tax system
estonia.description: According to a Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) fresh economic report on Estonia, the country should tighten its budget and reform taxes.

estonia.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy promises to work with Estonia in countering stray drones
estonia.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pledged to work with Estonia and other European countries supporting Ukraine to neutralize drones that have crossed into countries neighboring Russia after being diverted from their course due to Russian interference operations.

estonia.title: Man charged with attempted murder over Ülemiste mall blast
estonia.description: Prosecutors have charged a man with attempted murder following an explosion which took place at the Ülemiste keskus mall in Tallinn just before Christmas last year.

estonia.title: Watch: Press conference with NB8 leaders and Volodymyr Zelenskyy
estonia.description: The eight Nordic and Baltic leaders and the Ukrainian Volodymyr Zelenskyy will hold a press conference at the end of Tuesday's NB8 summit. You can watch the press conference on ERR News.

estonia.title: Merle Raun: Mental health policy cannot be separated from economic policy
estonia.description: While economic policy does not directly treat mental health problems, it can create conditions in which people have jobs, homes, prospects for the future and a sense that they have a place in society, Merle Raun writes.

estonia.title: Ukraine to open honorary consuls in Estonia's Narva and Tartu
estonia.description: Ukraine will open two new honorary consuls in Narva and Tartu after signing a bilateral agreement with Estonia on Tuesday.

estonia.title: IMF issues Estonia ballooning public debt warning
estonia.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned Estonia that if it continues on its current course, the country's public debt is heading down an unsustainable path.

estonia.title: Estonia allows longer truck combinations to boost efficiency
estonia.description: Estonia has begun allowing longer truck combinations on certain routes with special permits, a move aimed at improving freight efficiency and easing driver shortages.

estonia.title: New wildlife atlas shows Estonia's large predators expanding ranges
estonia.description: A new atlas of Estonia's mammals shows large predators expanding their range across the country, even as several smaller species have sharply declined or vanished altogether.

estonia.title: Gallery: Over 60 scarecrows steal the show at rural Estonian museum
estonia.description: More than 60 handmade scarecrows from across Estonia now stand watch over a meadow at Heimtali Museum in Viljandi County, giving old textiles a colorful new lease on life.

estonia.title: Estonia's ministers critical of plan to simplify divorce procedures
estonia.description: Critics of the plan to simplify divorce procedures argue it would come at the expense of the safety of domestic violence victims and children, while Minister of Justice Liisa Pakosta says the goal is precisely to better protect victims of violence.

estonia.title: Zelenskyy visit to focus on military aid, drones, Russia pressure
estonia.description: Meetings during Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's visit to Tallinn will focus primarily on military support for Ukraine, Ukrainian attack drones entering Baltic airspace, putting pressure on Russia, and possible peace negotiations, says Margus Kolga, foreign policy adviser to the Estonian President.

estonia.title: Gallery: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy visits Estonia for NB8 summit
estonia.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will be in Tallinn on Tuesday to attend the Nordic-Baltic cooperation summit and meet with President Alar Karis.

estonia.title: Expansion of state high schools in Tallinn hinges on budget decisions
estonia.description: City of Tallinn and Estonia's Ministry of Education are exploring a major overhaul of the capital's school network, including a possible expansion of state-run high schools, but any final decisions will depend on available funding in the national budget.

estonia.title: Watch again: Estonian and Ukrainian presidents' press conference
estonia.description: A joint press conference between the Estonian and Ukrainian presidents will take place at 12.40 p.m. at Kadriorg Palace, which can be watched live on ERR News.

estonia.title: Finnair launches direct flights from Finland to Saaremaa
estonia.description: Finland's national carrier Finnair launched direct flights between Helsinki and the Estonian island of Saaremaa on Monday.

estonia.title: Minister says Orthodox Church must cut ties with Moscow after high court ruling
estonia.description: Estonia's interior minister said Monday that the country's Supreme Court's decision upholding amendments to the churches law means the Estonian Christian Orthodox Church must sever its subordinate ties to the Moscow Patriarchate.

estonia.title: Mark Lajal loses in Yorkshire yet still goes through to main draw
estonia.description: Estonia's top tennis player Mark Lajal is through to the main draw at the ATP Challenger Ilkley tournament in Yorkshire, England, despite losing his final qualifier.

estonia.title: Riigikogu wants greater say in nuclear power station decisions
estonia.description: Lawmakers are proposing an amendment that would give the Riigikogu the final say on whether a nuclear power station can be built in Estonia.

estonia.title: Expert: Tick-borne encephalitis risk may be higher in towns than forests
estonia.description: While the scourge of ticks is often associated with summer in Estonia's countryside, the towns aren't tick-free either and may even pose greater risk, one expert said.

estonia.title: Maarja Vaino: A small nation must know its history
estonia.description: History, along with language and customs, is what makes a people a people. It is the reason one cannot simply become a member of another nation overnight: what is lacking is historical perspective, a collectively experienced history, writes Maarja Vaino.

estonia.title: Expert: Too soon to say Ukraine has seized the initiative in the war
estonia.description: Despite Ukraine striking targets ever deeper inside Russia, it cannot yet be said that Kyiv has seized the initiative in the war, as it still largely remains with the more offensively minded Russian military along the front line, security expert Rainer Saks said.

estonia.title: 4,500 square meter spa to open in Tallinn's Ülemiste City in 2028
estonia.description: A €10 million spa complex with family and adults-only areas will open in Tallinn's Ülemiste City in 2028, with construction due to start next year.

estonia.title: Justice Chancellor: Trail cameras should be treated like other surveillance
estonia.description: While trailcams provide a unique window on to Estonia's wildlife, care must be taken when processing images and footage of people, Chancellor of Justice Ülle Madise said.

estonia.title: Auditor general: Latvia's Rail Baltica delay will end up costing Estonia
estonia.description: Latvia's inability to complete Rail Baltic construction by the set deadline will inevitably end up costing Estonia as well, Auditor General Janar Holm said.

estonia.title: Henri Drell's Joventut Badalona books place in Spanish basketball league semifinals
estonia.description: Estonian basketball player Henri Drell was instrumental in his team Joventut Badalona's win, which has taken them to the semifinals of Spain's Liga ACB.

estonia.title: How modern crisis communication can benefit from plague mythology
estonia.description: Plague legends and modern communication about environment-related health crises have much in common, Estonian and Finnish researchers say. However, while official crisis communication places greater emphasis on restrictions, folklore focuses on people's active role and personal responsibility.

estonia.title: Prosecutors target swift procedural ruling in Isamaa probe
estonia.description: The Prosecutor's Office plans to make a procedural decision this summer in the investigation concerning the Isamaa party, to avoid it coinciding too closely with the parliamentary elections in the spring.

estonia.title: Passenger numbers for Tartu-Helsinki flights show steady growth
estonia.description: Passenger numbers on Finnair flights between Tartu and Helsinki have increased significantly this year due to improved stability, prompting preparations for a new public procurement process to secure the route's future.

estonia.title: Memorial stone unveiled at site of Forest Brothers bunker battle
estonia.description: A memorial stone has been unveiled at the site of a Lääne-Viru County engagement involving four members of the Forest Brothers, who held off a much larger Soviet force.

estonia.title: Images: Demolition of old ERR buildings to make room for new quarter in Kadriorg
estonia.description: A completely new residential and commercial quarter, traversed by a new pedestrian and bicycle street, is planned for the site of Estonian Public Broadcasting's (ERR) current deteriorated buildings on Faehlmanni and Gonsiori streets in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Supreme Court: Email content may be requested only with court authorization
estonia.description: Investigative authorities do not have the right, during criminal proceedings, to demand the contents of a suspect's email account from a service provider; this can be done only with a court warrant, the Supreme Court ruled.

estonia.title: Estonia's new policy to prevent newborn statelessness sets key rules for parents
estonia.description: A draft law submitted by the Estonian government to parliament would eliminate the current ability of parents with undetermined citizenship to refuse Estonian citizenship on behalf of their children, if doing so would leave the child stateless.

estonia.title: Study: Key to kids' academic success cooperation between home and kindergarten
estonia.description: When it comes to supporting the academic skills of 5-year-old children, parents' beliefs and cooperation with preschool teachers are more important than the number of learning activities carried out at home, according to a doctoral dissertation defended at Tallinn University.

estonia.title: Jüri Kolk: All men
estonia.description: A mentality that tolerates violence still prevails in Estonia and a very large share of society sides with the perpetrator, Jüri Kolk writes.

estonia.title: Estonian chess player Mai Narva qualifies for 2027 Women's World Cup
estonia.description: Estonian chess player Mai Narva has qualified for the Women's World Cup after finishing 10th at the European Women's European Championship (EWCC) in Batumi, Georgia.

estonia.title: Tallinn planning separate bike paths along Tehnika tänav
estonia.description: Tallinn is planning to build separate and safe bicycle paths along the entire length of Tehnika tänav and to fully reconstruct the Endla tänav and Paldiski maantee intersections.

estonia.title: Supreme Court rejects President's challenge to church law amendments
estonia.description: The Supreme Court of Estonia has rejected President Alar Karis's request to declare the amendments to the Churches and Congregations Act unconstitutional. The decision was made by 17 justices, six of whom dissented.

estonia.title: Poland's Marceli Bogusławski victorious in Tour of Estonia race
estonia.description: Polish cyclist Marceli Bogusławski won the Tour of Estonia race over the weekend.

estonia.title: 'Biting is not allowed', Estonia's police chief warns after attacks on officers
estonia.description: Estonia's police chief has said "teeth flash often" during recent attacks on police, following a high-profile incident involving a judge who allegedly bit an officer after being asked to leave a nightclub in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Hando Sutter: The government is making history
estonia.description: With the right goals and ambition, it is possible to make history in just a year by reducing costly and unnecessary bureaucracy, writes Hando Sutter.

estonia.title: Kaarel Tarand: Editorial desk looking for a censor
estonia.description: As it vigorously prepares for war, the Estonian legislature is undermining the already fragile bonds of trust within peacetime society, Kaarel Tarand writes in a commentary originally published in Sirp.

estonia.title: Gallery: Estonian olympic champion's remains brought home from Sweden to Saaremaa
estonia.description: The remains of an Estonian Olympic wrestling champion from the interwar era have been reburied on Saaremaa, after being brought back from Sweden.

estonia.title: Estonia's Mark Lajal shines in qualifying at Ilkley tennis event
estonia.description: Estonia's Mark Lajal is through to qualifying round two at the ATP Challenger Ilkley tournament in the United Kingdom, after defeating local player Anton Matusevich in three sets.

estonia.title: ESIMENE STUUDIO ⟩ Liina Kersna sõnul vajab ERRi seadus muutmist, kuna selle nõukogus valitseb poliitikute ülekaal
estonia.description: Homme läheb riigikogus teisele lugemisele seaduseelnõu, mis näeks ette, et Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu (ERR) nõukogus oleks üks ekspertliige enam kui on poliitikuid. ETV saates «Esimene Stuudio» leidis riigikogulane Liina Kersna (RE), et aasta enne valimisi on vaja seadust muuta, kuna institutsiooni nõukogus valitseb poliitikute ülekaal.

estonia.title: Patrik Kristal ajas leedulased närvi: Butkus lubas, et murrab mu jalaluud ära
estonia.description: Balti turniiri võidukas finaalis suurepärase mängu teinud ja leedulastele naha vahele pugenud Patrik Kristal (18) avaldas, et juba avaminutitel lubas üks vastane tema jalaluud murda.

estonia.title: 100 000 eurost ilma jäänud Leedu peatreener: Eesti võimsus oli meie jaoks liig mis liig!
estonia.description: Leedu koondise peatreener Edgaras Jankauskas leidis pärast Eestile 0:1 kaotatud Balti turniiri finaali, et tulemus oli õiglane ja vastas platsil nähtule.

estonia.title: VIDEOD ⟩ Robotid lõid keset etendust lapsi kõhtu ja näkku: kas tehnoloogia areng on läinud liiga kaugele?
estonia.description: Hiinas asuvas lõbustuspargis sattus etendusel osalenud robot publikule liiga lähedale ning lõi videokaadrite järgi last jalaga. Juhtum, mille video levis kiiresti sotsiaalmeedias, on tekitanud internetikasutajates vastakaid reaktsioone – osa peab olukorda koomiliseks, kuid enamik väljendab muret turvalisuse ja robotite kasutamise üle avalikel üritustel.

estonia.title: ANALÜÜS ⟩ Leedu pandi tuttu ja aeti närvi kah! Mitte keegi ei saa öelda, et Eesti pole Baltimaade parim!
estonia.description: Eesti meeste jalgpallikoondis alistas A. Le Coq Arenal mängitud Balti turniiri finaalis tänu Karel Mustmaa 80. minuti väravale 1:0 Leedu ja kaitses edukalt kaks aastat tagasi Kaunasest koju toodud kaussi.

estonia.title: Soome endine tipplaskesuusataja vahetas ametit
estonia.description: 43-aastane Soome endine tipplaskesuusataja Kaisa Mäkäräinen ja hilisem Yle spordikommentaator, valiti Soome laskesuusaliidu U21 koondise teiseks treeneriks.

estonia.title: JUHTKIRI ⟩ Liitlaste kogupauk Tallinnas
estonia.description: Teisipäeval kohtus Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi Tallinnas vabariigi presidendi Alar Karisega ning mitme teise riigi juhtidega, et anda diplomaatiline kogupauk Venemaale ja luua sellega eeldused tulevasteks rahuläbirääkimisteks.

estonia.title: OTSEBLOGI ⟩ Eesti tuli teist korda järjest Balti meistriks, solvunud leedulased soovisid lõpuvile järel kakelda
estonia.description: Nii nagu kaks aastat tagasi, alistas Eesti Balti turniiri finaalis Leedu. Seekordne kaotus läks leedulastele nii hinge, et lõpuvile järel mindi kättpidi kokku teiste seas ka Eesti abitreeneri Joel Indermittega. Postimees tegi mängust otseblogi.

estonia.title: MULLIGA VÕI MULLITA? ⟩ Jaagup Kreemi vastus käivitas kentsaka dialoogi: vastupidi, sellisel vahval peol tuleb lips just lõdvaks lasta
estonia.description: Juba sel laupäeval toimub Tallinnas Maarjamäe lossihoovis Mulliga & Mullita festival. Ühismeedias on lahti läinud aga tuline arutelu, kumb siis ikkagi, mulliga või mullita?

estonia.title: PPA: kui välja jätta plahvatanud ilutulestik, möödus Volodõmõr Zelenskõi visiit ladusalt
estonia.description: Põhja prefektuuri julgestusbüroo juhi Urmet Tambre sõnul möödus Ukraina presidendi Volodõmõr Zelenskõi ning Balti ja Põhjala riigijuhtide visiit Tallinna kui õlitatult, ainus vahejuhtum tekkis plahvatanud ilutulestiku tõttu.

estonia.title: Madonna pikantne ülestunnistus: elu parimat seksi pakkus see traagiliselt hukkunud legend
estonia.description: Kuigi surnud inimeste eraelu lahkamist peetakse tavaliselt matslikuks, ei suuda maailm praegu rääkida millestki muust. Põhjuseks on popikuninganna Madonna viimane, eriti pikantne paljastus oma kunagise voodipartneri kohta.

latvia.title: A hajánál fogva kérdezte a nőt, hogy megcsókolhatja-e – lesújtott a törvény a vonaton zaklató brit férfira
latvia.description: Ítélet született az első, nemi alapú zaklatást érintő büntetőeljárásban Nagy-Britanniában.

latvia.title: Lentulai Krisztián bocsánatot kért Magyar Péter anyjától
latvia.description: Amiért megosztotta Kocsis Máté becsületsértő posztját.

latvia.title: Ukrán dróncsapás ért egy személyvonatot a Krímben
latvia.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

latvia.title: Felmondott Papp Dániel, az MTVA vezérigazgatója
latvia.description: Az MTVA-t 2018 óta vezető Papp arra hivatkozott, hogy „az újonnan megválasztott kormány szándéka a közmédia teljes átalakítása.”

latvia.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
latvia.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. A könyv bemutatóján a szerzővel beszélgettünk.

latvia.title: Kinevezték a MÁV Szolgáltató Központ Zrt. új vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: A cég teljes megújulást ígér.

latvia.title: Bocsánatot kért egy német szálloda, mert azt írta egy izraeli érdeklődőnek, hogy zsidókat nem engednek a szállodába
latvia.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

latvia.title: Leváltották a Nemzeti Infokommunikációs Szolgáltató vezérigazgatóját is
latvia.description: Vetési Iván helyére Simon Lajost nevezte ki Tanács Zoltán tudományos és technológiai miniszter.

latvia.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
latvia.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

latvia.title: Azonnali hatállyal elbocsátották a MÁV Szolgáltató Központ Zrt. vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: Bada János az előző közlekedési miniszter, Lázár János gimnáziumi évfolyamtársa volt.

latvia.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
latvia.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

latvia.title: Már a Kreml is elismeri: tarolnak az ukrán drónok, fordulhat a kocka - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúból kedden
latvia.description: Már Dmitrij Peszkov Kreml-szóvivő is elismeri, hogy az ukrán mélységi dróncsapások komoly fejtörést okoznak az orosz üzemanyagellátásnak. A pilóta nélküli fegyvereknek hála az orosz területszerzés 2023 óta először negatívba fordult. A drónháború elmérgesedésével egyre gyakrabban bukkannak fel orosz és ukrán drónok NATO-tagállamok területén: Romániában egy ukrán tengeri drón okozott botrányt, a baltikumban repülő eszközök borzolják a kedélyeket. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfontosabb híreivel.

latvia.title: Paweł Kowal o obecności wojsk USA w Polsce. "Dobre wieści przywożę"
latvia.description: Przekaz jest jasny - Polska zasługuje na to, żeby skoncentrować to wsparcie Stanów Zjednoczonych na wschodniej flance NATO - powiedział szef sejmowej komisji spraw zagranicznych Paweł Kowal z KO. Poseł był niedawno gościem w amerykańskim Kongresie. O swojej wizycie mówił w "Faktach po Faktach" TVN24.

latvia.title: Konflikt o "Bohaterów UPA". Donald Tusk: Ukraina ma więcej roboty do wykonania
latvia.description: Trudne sąsiedzkie relacje trzeba budować na prawdzie i na próbie zrozumienia wzajemnych intencji. Ukraińcy tego nie zrobili i mamy dzisiaj z tym poważny kłopot - stwierdził Donald Tusk na konferencji prasowej. Jego zdaniem Ukraina powinna "przejąć odpowiedzialność za kryzys" spowodowany nazwaniem jednostki wojskowej imieniem "Bohaterów UPA". Szef rządu był również pytany, czemu prezydent Ukrainy poleciał do Londynu przez Mołdawię, a nie - jak zwykle - przez Rzeszów.

latvia.title: Rok temu "nie dawano jej szans", teraz ma "wyciągnąć partię z dołka"
latvia.description: Ma doświadczenie w wyborach i w zarządzaniu miastem, ale nie obciąża jej otoczenie poprzedniej ekipy. Senatorka Koalicji Obywatelskiej Monika Piątkowska została kandydatką na prezydenta Krakowa. - Jest w gronie faworytów, ale nie jest też bezapelacyjnym faworytem - skomentował dla TVN24+ prof. Jarosław Flis, socjolog z Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego.

latvia.title: ONLINE: Silný odkaz zo severu: Ukrajina smeruje nezvratne do NATO, v EÚ ju chcú čo najskôr
latvia.description: Vojna na Ukrajine trvá už 1 566 dní.

latvia.title: Lidé vyběhli při zemětřesení na Filipínách z restaurace jen pár vteřin předtím, než se zřítila
latvia.description: KRÁTCE: Děsivý okamžik natočil v pondělí očitý svědek během devastujícího zemětřesení na Filipínách. Na záběrech je vidět, jak šla k zemi budova, ve které sídlila restaurace Jollibee ve městě General Santos, jen zhruba 15 vteřin poté, co z ní vyběhli lidé. Při zemětřesení o síle 7,8 stupně Richterovy škály zemřelo podle nejnovějších informací nejméně 37 lidí a stovky dalších byly zraněny, uvádí agentura Reuters. Epicentrum se nacházelo v moři nedaleko od pobřeží ostrova Mindanao. Úřady vydaly také varování před tsunami.

latvia.title: Ruskou stínovou flotilu střeží Wagnerovci
latvia.description: Na lodích ruské stínové flotily hlídkují jako ozbrojená ochranka bývalí příslušníci ruské paramilitární organizace Wagnerovců. Mají sloužit jako odstrašení pro úřady zemí NATO a udržovat disciplínu u posádky.

latvia.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
latvia.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

latvia.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
latvia.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

latvia.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
latvia.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

latvia.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
latvia.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

latvia.title: Militari români și americani s-au antrenat împreună în Polonia. Mesajul Ambasadei SUA la București
latvia.description: Militari români și americani au participat la un antrenament comun în Polonia, iar imaginile au fost preluate de Ambasada SUA la București. Exercițiul militar a avut loc la Bemowo Piskie, unde este staționat Grupul de Luptă Multinațional al NATO în Polonia.

latvia.title: Avioane NATO au doborât o dronă intrată în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia
latvia.description: Avioane NATO au doborât luni o dronă care a intrat în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia, după ce autoritățile au emis avertizări pentru locuitorii din estul țării să se adăpostească. Originea aparatului de zbor nu a fost stabilită imediat.

latvia.title: Cum vor SUA să forțeze Iranul să ofere informații despre instalațiile nucleare bombardate și stocul de uraniu îmbogățit
latvia.description: Statele Unite fac lobby pe lângă alte ţări din Consiliul Guvernatorilor al Agenţiei Internaţionale pentru Energie Atomică (AIEA) să sprijine un proiect de rezoluţie care ar dispune Iranului să informeze acest organism cu privire la situaţia instalaţiilor sale nucleare bombardate anul trecut şi anul acesta de SUA şi Israel, precum a uraniului îmbogăţit depozitat acolo, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Metz Handball a câştigat în premieră Liga Campionilor, după ce a trecut în finală de Gyor, deținătoarea trofeului
latvia.description: Metz Handball a devenit prima echipă franceză care câştigă Liga Campionilor la handbal feminin, după ce a învins-o în finală pe Gyori Audi ETO KC, deţinătoarea trofeului, cu 31-29 (18-17), duminică, în MVM Dome din Budapesta, în timp ce CSM Bucureşti a obţinut medaliile de bronz.

latvia.title: Auditor general: Latvia's Rail Baltica delay will end up costing Estonia
latvia.description: Latvia's inability to complete Rail Baltic construction by the set deadline will inevitably end up costing Estonia as well, Auditor General Janar Holm said.

latvia.title: JUHTKIRI ⟩ Liitlaste kogupauk Tallinnas
latvia.description: Teisipäeval kohtus Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi Tallinnas vabariigi presidendi Alar Karisega ning mitme teise riigi juhtidega, et anda diplomaatiline kogupauk Venemaale ja luua sellega eeldused tulevasteks rahuläbirääkimisteks.

latvia.title: PPA: kui välja jätta plahvatanud ilutulestik, möödus Volodõmõr Zelenskõi visiit ladusalt
latvia.description: Põhja prefektuuri julgestusbüroo juhi Urmet Tambre sõnul möödus Ukraina presidendi Volodõmõr Zelenskõi ning Balti ja Põhjala riigijuhtide visiit Tallinna kui õlitatult, ainus vahejuhtum tekkis plahvatanud ilutulestiku tõttu.

latvia.title: FOTOD ⟩ Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi käis Tallinnas lähimate liitlastega mõtteid vahetamas
latvia.description: Tallinnas teisipäeval toimunud Põhjala ja Balti riikide peaministrite NB8 tippkohtumise raames külastas pärast täiemahulise sõja algust teist korda Eestit Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi koos abikaasa Olenaga.

latvia.title: GALERII ⟩ Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi lahkus Tallinnast
latvia.description: Tallinnas visiidil käinud Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi lahkus täna õhtul Tallinna lennujaamast Ukraina poole.

latvia.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Kulbergs: Läti võib saada Ukrainalt droonitõrjesüsteemid juba sel aastal
latvia.description: Läti sõlmis täna Ukrainaga kaitsekoostööleppe, mille alusel võivad Ukraina mehitamata droonitõrjesüsteemid jõuda Läti piiri turvama juba selle aasta jooksul, ütles Tallinnas Põhjala-Balti koostööformaadi (NB8) kohtumisel osalenud Läti peaminister Andris Kulbergs Postimehele.

latvia.title: Bulgaaria uus valitsus ei saada enam Ukrainale relvi
latvia.description: Bulgaaria uus Kremli suhtes sõbralikum valitsus teatas teisipäeval, et ei saada enam Ukrainale relvi.

latvia.title: Latvian football team wrecked on the shores of the Faroe Islands
latvia.description: Latvia finished rank last in this year's Baltic Cup football tournament on June 9th following a second defeat.

latvia.title: Plan to introduce e-cigarette deposit system still hanging in the air
latvia.description: Discussions on the potential introduction of an e-cigarette deposit system will continue in the Saeima, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Double-digit export rise for Latvia in April
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) provisional data published on June 9th show that in April 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of EUR 4.13 billion, which at current prices was 12.6 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Latvian government will pay pharmacist fees in future
latvia.description: Meanwhile, Ukrainian civilians covered by the Ukrainian Civilian Support Law will no longer be exempt from paying a pharmacist's service fee for a prescription.

latvia.title: Annual inflation at 3.5% in May in Latvia
latvia.description: The data of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) show that in May 2026, compared to April 2026, the average level of consumer prices increased by 0.5 %.

latvia.title: Estonia wants to fly cows from Rīga Airport
latvia.description: Estonia plans to use Riga Airport as its main transhipment and dispatch point for the export of live cattle to Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, according to information provided by the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) at Tuesday's government meeting, LSM.lv reports.

latvia.title: Coalition wants to keep reduced diesel tax until end of 2026
latvia.description: The coalition parties have agreed to maintain the reduced excise tax rates on diesel fuel until the end of this year, Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis told the LETA news agency on Monday following a meeting of the coalition parties.

latvia.title: Latvia and Ukraine sign defence cooperation agreement
latvia.description: On June 9th, the Latvian Cabinet of Ministers supported the Ministry of Defence's report "On the Agreement with Ukraine on Cooperation in the Field of Defense", which provides for comprehensive cooperation between the two countries over the next 10 years, with the possibility of a subsequent extension.

latvia.title: Valga Hot Shorts film fest returns in July
latvia.description: The enjoyable Valga Hot Shorts film festival is making a welcome return to the Estonian side of the Valka-Valga twin cities' border, and there's always plenty of Latvian interest in the showcase event, too.

latvia.title: Prototype Baltic bunker system being tested in Latvia
latvia.description: A prototype of the 'Baltic defence line' which is planned to be constructed along the borders of the Baltic states with Russia and Belarus is currently being constructed and tested at the Sēlija military training range in southern Latvia, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: ERR: Latvian Rail Baltica delays could cost Estonia
latvia.description: Latvia's inability to complete Rail Baltic construction by the set deadline will inevitably end up costing Estonia as well, Estonian Auditor General Janar Holm said, according to a report from Estonian public media ERR News.

latvia.title: Railway crossings to be upgraded, 'Latvian Railways' promises
latvia.description: "Latvian Railways" plans to improve safety conditions at and near 45 railroad crossings over the next two years. The company made this announcement on Monday following reports of a man being struck by a train in Imanta, Latvian Television reported on June 8.

latvia.title: Mūkusala promenade in Rīga to be fixed soon
latvia.description: After several months, repair work on the Mūkusalas Promenade in Riga is nearing completion. Although the promenade was opened to the public last December, the contractor had to address deficiencies identified immediately after opening. The work is scheduled to be completed this month, Latvian Television reported on June 9.

latvia.title: New book of stories published in easy Latvian language
latvia.description: The "Valters un Rapa" publishing house and book shop has published a third book in its series "Stories in Easy Language", continuing its work in promoting the accessibility of original Latvian literature to everyone.

latvia.title: Why do Latvian universities spend thousands to attract foreign students?
latvia.description: Latvian higher education institutions spend thousands to attract foreign students to their courses. How and why this happens, Latvian Radio explained for the benefit of anyone unable to work it out for themselves.

latvia.title: Baltic and Nordic Prime Ministers meet Zelenskyy in Tallinn
latvia.description: The Prime Ministers of the Baltic and Nordic states are in Tallinn, Estonia on Tuesday for a meeting with Ukraine's outstanding President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Drone search will likely not continue in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, the wreckage of the drone that was shot down in Latvian airspace was not found, as it most likely "broke into many small pieces," Māris Tūtins, head of the Information Analysis and Management Department of the Joint Staff of the National Armed Forces (NBS), told the Latvian Television programme Morning Panorama on June 9.

latvia.title: Latvian nature researcher Guntis Eniņš passes away aged 92
latvia.description: Latvia has lost a legendary naturalist and guardian of trees – Guntis Eniņš, who would have celebrated his 93rd birthday on June 18.

latvia.title: Latvian interceptor drones being tested for use on eastern border
latvia.description: During the international military exercises "Baltic Zenith 2026" currently taking place at the Jūrmalciems military aviation training ground, Latvian-made interceptor drones are being tested. The Ministry of Defence says that such systems are planned to be deployed to defend the eastern border, Kurzeme Television reported on June 8.

latvia.title: Latvian volunteer soldier in Ukraine dies
latvia.description: Latvian volunteer soldier Uldis Volmārs has passed away. He was one of the first to go to the front lines in February 2022 to help the Ukrainians, Latvian Television reports.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rēzekne's former mayor incriminated in expensive spa case
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) is calling for criminal proceedings to be initiated against the former mayor of Rēzekne, Aleksandrs Bartaševičs (Together for Latvia), who may have abused his official position regarding the construction of a spa centre, KNAB stated on June 8.

latvia.title: Drone downing shows NATO willingness to defend Latvia, says senior soldier
latvia.description: The first ever downing of a foreign drone in Latvian airspace on Monday, June 8th confirms the NATO alliance's determination to protect every centimetre of the country, Brigadier General Ilmārs Atis Lejiņš, Deputy Commander of NATO's Multinational Division "North", said on the Latvian Radio programme 'Krustpunktā' ('At the Crossroads').

latvia.title: Latvia targets illicit cigarette factories via equipment suppliers
latvia.description: In order to improve customs risk management and increase the efficiency of control, the Customs Administration department of Latvia's tax service, VID with the support of experts from the European Commission (EC), has launched a new initiative which aims to identify cigarette production equipment, components and the raw materials necessary for illicit cigarette production, using the Safety and Security Analytics (SSA) system developed by the EC and the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI).

latvia.title: Latvia had nearly 20 thousand vacancies in first quarter
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on June 8 show that in Q1 2026, the Latvian labour market had 19.8 thousand job vacancies, of which 10.8 thousand jobs were vacant in the private sector and 8.9 thousand in the public sector.

latvia.title: Stamp honours Latvian para-athletes
latvia.description: On June 12, Latvijas Pasts will issue a stamp dedicated to the first medal, a bronze, won by Latvian athletes at the Winter Paralympic Games.

latvia.title: WATCH: Estonian and Latvian Prime Ministers' press conference
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs makes his first foreign visit since assuming power on Monday, May 8th, with a short trip north to Estonia.

latvia.title: Mosquitoes will arrive around Midsummer, says bug expert
latvia.description: The feeling that there have been fewer mosquitoes so far this year is indeed justified, entomologist Voldemārs Spuņģis confirmed in an interview with LSM.lv on June 8.

latvia.title: Rothko Museum opens Summer season in Daugavpils
latvia.description: On Friday, 5th June, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils opened its summer exhibition season, bringing together photography, painting and ceramics from Latvia, Lithuania, China and South Africa.

latvia.title: Second air hazard alert in eastern Latvia is now over
latvia.description: A second air threat alert in eastern Latvia on Monday is now over.

latvia.title: Rīga meeting helps advance single Baltic capital market concept
latvia.description: On Saturday, June 6th, during the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in Rīga, the Finance Ministers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania, together with EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, signed a memorandum of understanding on further cooperation in the development of a single Baltic capital market.

latvia.title: Foreign Affairs Committees of Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Türkiye meet in Tallinn
latvia.description: On June 8th and 9th, the delegations of the Foreign Affairs Committees of the parliaments of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania will meet with their counterparts from the Parliament of Türkiye in Tallinn, Estonia, to discuss the security situation and further support to Ukraine.

latvia.title: Mixed picture on Latvian labour productivity
latvia.description: In the first quarter of 2026, labour productivity in the EU increased slightly by 0.1% based on both persons and hours worked, compared with the same quarter of the previous year, according to fresh Eurostat statistics.

latvia.title: Latvia shows off new 'Hunter' military vehicle
latvia.description: A new infantry fighting vehicle named 'Hunter' was presented on Saturday at the Valmiera military vehicle factory Patria Latvia.

latvia.title: Lots of rain this week in Latvia
latvia.description: Rain is often expected in Latvia this week, according to forecasts.

latvia.title: Drone shot down by NATO jets in eastern Latvia
latvia.description: The airspace threat that was announced in Latvia on Monday morning is over at around 10:30 in the morning, said the National Armed Forces (NBS).

latvia.title: Blood needed urgently in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Blood Donor Centre (VADC) is urging the public to donate blood, as there is currently a critical shortage of donors for all blood types, Latvian Television's Morning Panorama reports on June 8.

latvia.title: Caterers argue about school procurement in Rīga
latvia.description: The Rīga City Council has amended the catering procurement contract for schools and kindergartens after two companies challenged the green criteria regarding organic food and delivery distance. As reported by the Latvian Television programme "De Facto," organic farmers are concerned that this could make it harder for organic food to reach children’s menus.

latvia.title: Deaths in prisons a cause for concern in Latvia, says Justice Minister
latvia.description: Minister of Justice Edvards Smiltēns (United List) has instructed the Prison Administration to submit, by June 10, a detailed report on the death of a juvenile inmate at the Olaine Prison Hospital, as well as on the overall situation regarding deaths and suicides in prisons, LETA reports.

latvia.title: eID microchip issue postponed but not resolved in Latvia
latvia.description: Nearly 350,000 people have ID cards with chips that will no longer be suitable for creating electronic signatures. The French authorities responsible for its certification have granted a six-month extension until December 9. However, it is still too early to say that the problem will be resolved by then, reports Latvian Television's De Facto on June 8.

latvia.title: Man run over by train in Rīga, Latvia
latvia.description: A man was killed in Riga on Sunday, June 7th in the evening after being struck by a train, the State Police told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: June 7th, 2026

latvia.description: A yellow (potential danger) alert has been issued across a large part of eastern and northern Latvia on Monday and Tuesday.

latvia.description: On Sunday, June 7th the Latvian men's volleyball team will face Kosovo in international competition.

latvia.description: On June 6th, the Eurovision Young Musicians competition took place in Yerevan, Armenia.

latvia.description: Igaunijas galvaspilsētā Tallinā notiekošā Baltijas valstu un Ziemeļvalstu (NB8) samita laikā Latvijas Ministru prezidents Andris Kulbergs (AS) un Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis parakstīja abu valstu vienošanos par visaptverošu sadarbību aizsardzības jomā, nodrošinot Ukrainas pieredzes pārņemšanu gaisa telpas aizsardzībai pret dronu uzbrukumiem, aģentūrai LETA pavēstīja Kulberga komunikācijas padomniece Elīna Šverna. latvia.description: Ukraiņi arvien biežāk un biežāk izvēlas pamest Poliju, bet viņu darbavietas aizņem migranti no Āzijas un Latīņamerikas. Kā raksta Polijas portāls WNP, šī tendence kļūst arvien izteiktāka, radot bažas par iespējamo ietekmi uz Polijas ekonomiku, kurā ukraiņu darbaspēkam pēdējos gados bijusi būtiska loma. lithuania.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. lithuania.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

lithuania.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
lithuania.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

lithuania.title: Már a Kreml is elismeri: tarolnak az ukrán drónok, fordulhat a kocka - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúból kedden
lithuania.description: Már Dmitrij Peszkov Kreml-szóvivő is elismeri, hogy az ukrán mélységi dróncsapások komoly fejtörést okoznak az orosz üzemanyagellátásnak. A pilóta nélküli fegyvereknek hála az orosz területszerzés 2023 óta először negatívba fordult. A drónháború elmérgesedésével egyre gyakrabban bukkannak fel orosz és ukrán drónok NATO-tagállamok területén: Romániában egy ukrán tengeri drón okozott botrányt, a baltikumban repülő eszközök borzolják a kedélyeket. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfontosabb híreivel.

lithuania.title: Paweł Kowal o obecności wojsk USA w Polsce. "Dobre wieści przywożę"
lithuania.description: Przekaz jest jasny - Polska zasługuje na to, żeby skoncentrować to wsparcie Stanów Zjednoczonych na wschodniej flance NATO - powiedział szef sejmowej komisji spraw zagranicznych Paweł Kowal z KO. Poseł był niedawno gościem w amerykańskim Kongresie. O swojej wizycie mówił w "Faktach po Faktach" TVN24.

lithuania.title: Konflikt o "Bohaterów UPA". Donald Tusk: Ukraina ma więcej roboty do wykonania
lithuania.description: Trudne sąsiedzkie relacje trzeba budować na prawdzie i na próbie zrozumienia wzajemnych intencji. Ukraińcy tego nie zrobili i mamy dzisiaj z tym poważny kłopot - stwierdził Donald Tusk na konferencji prasowej. Jego zdaniem Ukraina powinna "przejąć odpowiedzialność za kryzys" spowodowany nazwaniem jednostki wojskowej imieniem "Bohaterów UPA". Szef rządu był również pytany, czemu prezydent Ukrainy poleciał do Londynu przez Mołdawię, a nie - jak zwykle - przez Rzeszów.

lithuania.title: Rok temu "nie dawano jej szans", teraz ma "wyciągnąć partię z dołka"
lithuania.description: Ma doświadczenie w wyborach i w zarządzaniu miastem, ale nie obciąża jej otoczenie poprzedniej ekipy. Senatorka Koalicji Obywatelskiej Monika Piątkowska została kandydatką na prezydenta Krakowa. - Jest w gronie faworytów, ale nie jest też bezapelacyjnym faworytem - skomentował dla TVN24+ prof. Jarosław Flis, socjolog z Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego.

lithuania.title: ONLINE: Silný odkaz zo severu: Ukrajina smeruje nezvratne do NATO, v EÚ ju chcú čo najskôr
lithuania.description: Vojna na Ukrajine trvá už 1 566 dní.

lithuania.title: Lidé vyběhli při zemětřesení na Filipínách z restaurace jen pár vteřin předtím, než se zřítila
lithuania.description: KRÁTCE: Děsivý okamžik natočil v pondělí očitý svědek během devastujícího zemětřesení na Filipínách. Na záběrech je vidět, jak šla k zemi budova, ve které sídlila restaurace Jollibee ve městě General Santos, jen zhruba 15 vteřin poté, co z ní vyběhli lidé. Při zemětřesení o síle 7,8 stupně Richterovy škály zemřelo podle nejnovějších informací nejméně 37 lidí a stovky dalších byly zraněny, uvádí agentura Reuters. Epicentrum se nacházelo v moři nedaleko od pobřeží ostrova Mindanao. Úřady vydaly také varování před tsunami.

lithuania.title: Ruskou stínovou flotilu střeží Wagnerovci
lithuania.description: Na lodích ruské stínové flotily hlídkují jako ozbrojená ochranka bývalí příslušníci ruské paramilitární organizace Wagnerovců. Mají sloužit jako odstrašení pro úřady zemí NATO a udržovat disciplínu u posádky.

lithuania.title: Răspunsul lui Putin la provocarea Lituaniei: Manevre navale ale Rusiei în Marea Baltică, concomitent cu un exerciţiu major al NATO
lithuania.description: Marina rusă a desfăşurat exerciţii militare în Marea Baltică, exersând lansări de rachete neghidate, bombardamente şi atacuri cu rachete, a declarat aceasta, în timp ce în regiune aveau loc totodată exerciţii majore ale SUA şi NATO, a relatat marţi agenţia de ştiri Interfax, preluată de Reuters.

lithuania.title: FIDELIS revine din 15 iunie cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% în lei și 6,80% în euro. Facilități speciale pentru donatorii de sânge
lithuania.description: Ministerul Finanțelor lansează o nouă ediție a programului FIDELIS în perioada 15-22 iunie 2026, cu dobânzi de până la 7,60% pentru titlurile în lei și până la 6,80% pentru cele în euro. Noua ediție vine și cu două tranșe speciale dedicate donatorilor de sânge, în contextul Zilei Internaționale a Donatorului de Sânge, marcată anual pe 14 iunie.

lithuania.title: Simion reia tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan: cere părerea susținătorilor, pe Facebook. De ce este, de fapt, un proces complicat
lithuania.description: Liderul AUR a readus în discuție tema suspendării lui Nicușor Dan. De această dată și-a întrebat urmăritorii, printr-o postare pe Facebook, dacă ar trebui să inițieze un astfel de demers. Între lansarea procedurii suspendare și demiterea efectivă a președintelui există însă două praguri esențiale, destul de greu de trecut în acest moment: votul majorității parlamentarilor și validarea rezultatului prin referendum.

lithuania.title: Ce paradă pregătește Franța de ziua sa națională, 14 iulie: „Europa nu este singură”. Ucraina va fi omagiată
lithuania.description: Parada militară de pe 14 iulie de pe Champs Elysées va fi „mai masivă”, va avea drept temă „trezirea strategică a Europei” şi va încerca să arate că Franţa este „hotărâtă” şi „nu este singură”, a anunţat luni guvernatorul militar al Parisului, relatează AFP.

lithuania.title: Militari români și americani s-au antrenat împreună în Polonia. Mesajul Ambasadei SUA la București
lithuania.description: Militari români și americani au participat la un antrenament comun în Polonia, iar imaginile au fost preluate de Ambasada SUA la București. Exercițiul militar a avut loc la Bemowo Piskie, unde este staționat Grupul de Luptă Multinațional al NATO în Polonia.

lithuania.title: Avioane NATO au doborât o dronă intrată în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia
lithuania.description: Avioane NATO au doborât luni o dronă care a intrat în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia, după ce autoritățile au emis avertizări pentru locuitorii din estul țării să se adăpostească. Originea aparatului de zbor nu a fost stabilită imediat.

lithuania.title: Cum vor SUA să forțeze Iranul să ofere informații despre instalațiile nucleare bombardate și stocul de uraniu îmbogățit
lithuania.description: Statele Unite fac lobby pe lângă alte ţări din Consiliul Guvernatorilor al Agenţiei Internaţionale pentru Energie Atomică (AIEA) să sprijine un proiect de rezoluţie care ar dispune Iranului să informeze acest organism cu privire la situaţia instalaţiilor sale nucleare bombardate anul trecut şi anul acesta de SUA şi Israel, precum a uraniului îmbogăţit depozitat acolo, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Metz Handball a câştigat în premieră Liga Campionilor, după ce a trecut în finală de Gyor, deținătoarea trofeului
lithuania.description: Metz Handball a devenit prima echipă franceză care câştigă Liga Campionilor la handbal feminin, după ce a învins-o în finală pe Gyori Audi ETO KC, deţinătoarea trofeului, cu 31-29 (18-17), duminică, în MVM Dome din Budapesta, în timp ce CSM Bucureşti a obţinut medaliile de bronz.

lithuania.title: Rothko Museum opens Summer season in Daugavpils
lithuania.description: On Friday, 5th June, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils opened its summer exhibition season, bringing together photography, painting and ceramics from Latvia, Lithuania, China and South Africa.

lithuania.title: Rīga meeting helps advance single Baltic capital market concept
lithuania.description: On Saturday, June 6th, during the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in Rīga, the Finance Ministers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania, together with EBRD President Odile Renaud-Basso, signed a memorandum of understanding on further cooperation in the development of a single Baltic capital market.

lithuania.title: Foreign Affairs Committees of Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Türkiye meet in Tallinn
lithuania.description: On June 8th and 9th, the delegations of the Foreign Affairs Committees of the parliaments of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania will meet with their counterparts from the Parliament of Türkiye in Tallinn, Estonia, to discuss the security situation and further support to Ukraine.
